title: GatewayRemotePolicyConfigSchema
description: Environment variable schema for remote policy and reconciliation features

GITHUB_API_GATEWAY_POLICY_PATH.description: Path on disk (e.g. policy.yaml) or HTTP/HTTPS URL (e.g. https://git.corp/policy.yaml)

GITHUB_API_GATEWAY_POLICY_POLL_INTERVAL.description: Go duration string defining frequency of remote policy reconciliation (e.g. 30s, 1m). Empty disables polling.

GITHUB_API_GATEWAY_ALLOW_REMOTE_ADMIN.description: When true, enables non-loopback network callers to access /_gateway/reload using Bearer token authentication

GITHUB_API_GATEWAY_ADMIN_TOKEN.description: Secret Bearer token required for /_gateway/reload when remote admin is enabled or for SSRF loopback protection
